calls.preview:
Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.
  store

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.
  store

calls.name: describe_data
calls.preview:
Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.
  store

input.query:
SELECT DISTINCT p.PRD_CD AS product_ndc, s.SUBST_NM, s.UNII_CD
FROM wh.T_PRD_MSTR p
JOIN wh.T_PRD_INGR i ON i.PRD_SK = p.PRD_SK
JOIN wh.T_SUBST_MSTR s ON s.SUBST_SK = i.SUBST_SK
WHERE (s.SUBST_NM ILIKE '%POTASSIUM CHLORIDE%' OR s.UNII_CD = '660YQ98I10'
   OR s.SUBST_SK IN (SELECT sm.SUBST_SK FROM wh.X_SALT_MOIETY sm JOIN wh.T_SUBST_MSTR m ON m.SUBST_SK = sm.MOIETY_SUBST_SK WHERE m.UNII_CD='660YQ98I10'))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wh.T_PRD_RTE r JOIN wh.T_REF_CD rc ON rc.CD_VAL = r.RTE_CD AND rc.CD_DOM='RTE' WHERE r.PRD_SK = p.PRD_SK AND rc.CD_DSC ILIKE '%ORAL%')
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT DISTINCT p.PRD_CD, s.SUBST_NM, s.UNII_CD, rc.CD_DSC
FROM wh.T_PRD_MSTR p
JOIN wh.T_PRD_INGR i ON i.PRD_SK = p.PRD_SK
JOIN wh.T_SUBST_MSTR s ON s.SUBST_SK = i.SUBST_SK
LEFT JOIN wh.T_PRD_RTE r ON r.PRD_SK = p.PRD_SK
LEFT JOIN wh.T_REF_CD rc ON rc.CD_VAL = r.RTE_CD AND rc.CD_DOM='RTE'
WHERE s.SUBST_NM ILIKE '%POTASSIUM CHLORIDE%' OR s.UNII_CD = '660YQ98I10'
ORDER BY 1;

queries.query:

JOIN wh.T_SUBST_MSTR s ON s.SUBST_SK = i.SUBST_SK

AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wh.T_PRD_RTE r JOIN wh.T_REF_CD rc ON rc.CD_VAL = r.RTE_CD AND rc.CD_DOM='RTE' WHERE r.PRD_SK = p.PRD_SK AND rc.CD_DSC ILIKE '%ORAL%')
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT DISTINCT p.PRD_CD, s.SUBST_NM, s.UNII_CD, rc.CD_DSC

WHERE s.SUBST_NM ILIKE '%POTASSIUM CHLORIDE%' OR s.UNII_CD = '660YQ98I10'
ORDER BY 1;

input.query:
SELECT DISTINCT p.PRD_CD AS product_ndc, o.ORG_NM, d.CD_DSC AS form, r.CD_DSC AS route
FROM wh.T_PKG k
JOIN wh.T_ORG_MSTR o ON o.ORG_SK = k.LBLR_ORG_SK
JOIN wh.T_PRD_MSTR p ON p.PRD_SK = k.PRD_SK
LEFT JOIN wh.T_REF_CD d ON d.CD_DOM='DSG_FRM' AND d.CD_VAL = p.DSG_FRM_CD
JOIN wh.T_PRD_RTE pr ON pr.PRD_SK = p.PRD_SK
JOIN wh.T_REF_CD r ON r.CD_DOM='RTE' AND r.CD_VAL = pr.RTE_CD
WHERE (o.ORG_NM ILIKE '%sun pharma%' OR o.ORG_CD ILIKE '%sun-pharma%' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wh.X_ORG_ALIAS a WHERE a.ORG_SK=o.ORG_SK AND a.ALIAS_NM ILIKE '%sun pharma%'))
AND d.CD_DSC ILIKE '%SOLUTION%' AND r.CD_DSC ILIKE '%TOPICAL%'

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.

  version: "1.0.0"
  description: "Semantic layer over the drug data warehouse (schema wh): FDA drug products and packages, their ingredients and labelers, adverse event reports and recalls. Query the views in schema sem; codes are already decoded into labels, dates are real dates and flags are booleans."
  entities:
    - name: "product"
      view: "sem.products"
      grain: "one row per product (product NDC)"
      description: "Drug products as listed in the FDA NDC directory, one row per product NDC (labeler and product code)."
      primary_key: "product_ndc"
      synonyms:
        - "drug product"
        - "NDC product"
        - "drug"
        - "medication"
      dimensions:
        - name: "product_ndc"
          type: "text"
          description: "Product NDC in 4-4, 5-3 or 5-4 form."
        - name: "product_name"
          type: "text"
          description: "Name as listed."
          synonyms:
            - "brand name"
            - "trade name"
        - name: "dosage_form"
          type: "text"
          description: "Dosage form as written in the source. Values are FDA SPL dosage form terms in capitals, for example

input.query:
SELECT DISTINCT p.product_ndc, p.product_name, p.dosage_form, s.substance_unii, s.substance_name
FROM sem.products p
JOIN sem.product_ingredients i ON i.product_ndc = p.product_ndc
JOIN sem.substances s ON s.substance_unii = i.substance_unii
JOIN sem.product_routes r ON r.product_ndc = p.product_ndc
WHERE s.substance_name ILIKE '%petrolatum%' AND r.route = 'OPHTHALMIC'
ORDER BY 1

queries.query:

JOIN sem.substances s ON s.substance_unii = i.substance_unii
JOIN sem.product_routes r ON r.product_ndc = p.product_ndc
WHERE s.substance_name ILIKE '%petrolatum%' AND r.route = 'OPHTHALMIC'

calls.name: describe_data
calls.preview:
Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.
  store

FROM wh.T_RCL_PRD_DNRM r
JOIN wh.T_PRD_MSTR p ON p.PRD_SK = r.PRD_SK

JOIN wh.T_REF_CD c ON c.CD_VAL = pr.RTE_CD AND c.CD_DOM = 'RTE'

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.

  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.

      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.

calls.name: describe_data
calls.preview:
Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.
  store

WITH brand AS (
  SELECT CLIN_DRG_SK, RXCUI, CLIN_DRG_NM FROM wh.T_CLIN_DRG WHERE CLIN_DRG_NM ILIKE 'empagliflozin 5 MG / metformin hydrochloride 1000 MG Oral Tablet [Synjardy]%'
),
gen AS (
  SELECT g.GNRC_CLIN_DRG_SK AS gsk FROM wh.X_BRND_GNRC g JOIN brand b ON g.BRND_CLIN_DRG_SK = b.CLIN_DRG_SK
),
mapped AS (
  SELECT p.PRD_CD FROM wh.T_PRD_MSTR p WHERE p.RXN_CLIN_DRG_SK IN (SELECT gsk FROM gen)
  UNION
  SELECT p.PRD_CD FROM wh.X_NDC_RXN x JOIN wh.T_PRD_MSTR p ON x.PRD_SK = p.PRD_SK WHERE x.CLIN_DRG_SK IN (SELECT gsk FROM gen)
)

UNION ALL SELECT 'generic', c.RXCUI, c.CLIN_DRG_NM FROM wh.T_CLIN_DRG c WHERE c.CLIN_DRG_SK IN (SELECT gsk FROM gen)
UNION ALL SELECT 'product', m.PRD_CD, NULL FROM mapped m;

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.

calls.preview:
Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.
  store

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.

The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.

      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

calls.name: describe_data
calls.preview:
Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.

  SELECT d.AE_SK, d.DRG_SEQ FROM wh.T_AE_DRG d WHERE d.CLIN_DRG_SK IN (SELECT CLIN_DRG_SK FROM c)

calls.preview:
Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.
  store

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.

      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.

calls.preview:
Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.
  store

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

WITH c AS (SELECT CLIN_DRG_SK, RXCUI, CLIN_DRG_NM, TTY_CD FROM wh.T_CLIN_DRG WHERE RXCUI = '90274885'),
m AS (
  SELECT p.PRD_CD AS product_ndc, 'own' AS src FROM wh.T_PRD_MSTR p JOIN c ON p.RXN_CLIN_DRG_SK = c.CLIN_DRG_SK
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.PRD_CD, 'map_' || x.SRC_CD FROM wh.X_NDC_RXN x JOIN c ON x.CLIN_DRG_SK = c.CLIN_DRG_SK JOIN wh.T_PRD_MSTR p ON p.PRD_SK = x.PRD_SK
)
